title: Law, Digital Rights, and Privacy
summary: Legal principles, personal data, consent, platform responsibility, and digital rights.
whyItMatters: Digital services turn ordinary actions into data, making consent, transparency, security, access, and accountability practical civic questions.

mentalModel.title: Rights, duties, and procedures
mentalModel.content: A right becomes usable only when responsible actors, limits, and a procedure for enforcement are clear.

mentalModel.title: Data creates linked risks
mentalModel.content: Collection, combination, inference, sharing, retention, and security each create distinct privacy concerns.

ruleBlocks.title: Apply core data principles
ruleBlocks.content: Examine purpose limitation, data minimization, transparency, accuracy, storage duration, and security.

ruleBlocks.title: Evaluate meaningful consent
ruleBlocks.content: Ask whether the choice is informed, specific, voluntary, understandable, and reversible.

ruleBlocks.title: Connect violations to remedies
ruleBlocks.content: Distinguish information, correction, deletion, objection, review, and compensation.

examples.de: Eine Einwilligung ist fragwürdig, wenn die Ablehnung wesentlich schwieriger ist als die Zustimmung.
examples.en: Consent is questionable if refusal is substantially harder than acceptance.

examples.de: Auch aus harmlosen Einzeldaten können sensible Profile abgeleitet werden.
examples.en: Sensitive profiles can be inferred even from individually harmless data.

examples.de: Plattformen tragen Verantwortung dafür, Beschwerdewege verständlich und zugänglich zu gestalten.
examples.en: Platforms are responsible for making complaint procedures understandable and accessible.

commonMistakes.wrong: Assume publicly visible data may be used for any purpose.
commonMistakes.correct: Separate visibility from lawful and context-appropriate reuse.
commonMistakes.reason: Purpose and reasonable expectations still matter.

commonMistakes.wrong: Treat privacy and security as identical.
commonMistakes.correct: Security protects data; privacy also concerns legitimate collection and use.
commonMistakes.reason: Secure processing can still be excessive or unfair.

comparisons.summary: Modal verbs help distinguish verified facts from reports, assumptions, and allegations.
The communication lesson turns rights and documented facts into a proportionate request.
